batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2022-2023, Set-U — full 80-question paper transcribed from publisher compilation ju-a-unit-question-solution-2022-2023.pdf, PDF pages 25-29 (book pages 25-29): Short Syllabus questions on pp.25-28 plus Extra Syllabus questions on p.29 together complete Q1-80. Printed publisher answer keys ([Ans: x] / printed solutions) preserved as-is; NOT official JU keys. All contentVerificationStatus=unverified pending cross-source verification. Q05 and Q66: printed solution states no correct option exists among the printed options, recorded as no_correct_option. IQ questions keep source subject label 'IQ' per REPO_FINDINGS (non-canonical subjects keep source label); Botany/Zoology mapped to canonical Biology with split kept in topic. Cross-source verification 2026-10-31 vs Satt Academy: 57 of 80 questions publicly comparable; 54 content-verified and included in the import-ready copy. TWO key conflicts — Q3 (compilation key a vs Satt b) and Q76 (compilation key b vs Satt c): following the JU A Set-I precedent, the independent source's values are recorded and both answers are marked unverified. Q34-Q36 show truncated combination options in Satt's text layer and remain content-unverified (their keys agree). Figure questions Q32 and Q73 were additionally confirmed against the figures embedded in Satt's cards. 23 questions were not publicly readable on Satt (including both no-correct-option items Q5 and Q66, which rest on the compilation's printed solutions alone) and remain unverified; those 26 are excluded from the import-ready copy and remain in the archived full pack. Detail: VERIFICATION/SOURCE_EVIDENCE/ju-d-2022-2023-setu.VERIFICATION.md.
